name: Rancid Air grants its Runic Power on Putrefy (#2374)
contract: Rancid Air 704726 reads 'Putrefy now generates an additional 5 Runic Power and the cast time is reduced by 10%'. The cast-time half runs through the native spellmod path - aura 108, op 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), routed to Putrefy's roots by 8fc77419f - and the talent is now marked passive (42edb88ec) so its aura registers at learn at all. The resource half has no SpellModOp, so spell_ascension_necromancer_ability grants it on the cast records only: casting Putrefy 561125 triggers 804559, which already energizes +150 Runic Power, and binding that triggered record as well would pay the bonus twice. The amount is the tooltip's own $/10;S1 over base points 49, which the original reference data renders as 'an additional 5 Runic Power'.
